source: In the S bus, in the rush hour. A chap of about 26, felt hat with a cord instead of a ribbon, neck too long, as if someone’s been having a tug-of-war with it. People getting off. The chap in question gets annoyed with one of the men standing next to him. He accuses him of jostling him every time anyone goes past. A snivelling tone which is meant to be aggressive. When he sees a vacant seat he throws himself on to it. Two hours later, I meet him in the Cour de Rome, in front of the gare Saint-Lazare. He’s with a friend who’s saying: "You ought to get an extra button put on your overcoat." He shows him where (at the lapels) and why.
prompt:
You are assisting with a scholarly experiment in structural literary analysis.

TASK: Write an ORIGINAL short prose passage in English, set in the target scenario below. It must be
a HOMEOSYNTACTIC transposition of a hidden source: hold the source's syntactic form at the level
specified below while inventing entirely new words and moving the content into the target
scenario. It is NOT a paraphrase or a translation.

FORM TARGET (hold this). Reproduce, period by period, the CLAUSE ARCHITECTURE below --- the same inventory and nesting of clauses (main / relative / adverbial / complement / coordinate, to the stated depth). The WORD ORDER and the words themselves are entirely yours; only the clause skeleton is fixed.
Reproduce it for all 10 periods, in this order:
Period 1 (~8 words) clause architecture: 1 main clause; subordination nested up to depth 0.
Period 2 (~29 words) clause architecture: 1 main clause; 1 open complement (infinitive); 1 adverbial clause; subordination nested up to depth 1.
Period 3 (~3 words) clause architecture: 1 main clause; subordination nested up to depth 0.
Period 4 (~15 words) clause architecture: 1 main clause; 1 relative/adnominal clause; subordination nested up to depth 1.
Period 5 (~11 words) clause architecture: 1 main clause; 1 adverbial clause; 1 relative/adnominal clause; subordination nested up to depth 2.
Period 6 (~9 words) clause architecture: 1 main clause; 1 relative/adnominal clause; 1 open complement (infinitive); subordination nested up to depth 2.
Period 7 (~12 words) clause architecture: 1 adverbial clause; 1 main clause; subordination nested up to depth 1.
Period 8 (~18 words) clause architecture: 1 main clause; subordination nested up to depth 0.
Period 9 (~19 words) clause architecture: 2 relative/adnominal clause; 1 main clause; 1 finite complement clause; 1 open complement (infinitive); subordination nested up to depth 4.
Period 10 (~9 words) clause architecture: 1 main clause; 1 finite complement clause; subordination nested up to depth 1.

TARGET SCENARIO --- render the content here (in your own words):
  - a supermarket checkout line at a busy hour
  - the conveyor belt, the barcode scanner, the bagging area, the card reader
  - the cashier and a shopper; a cart, a divider bar, a receipt
  - another shopper crowding from behind; a small friction over space in the queue
  - the register of retail routine: beeps, the total announced, loyalty-card prompts

REQUIREMENTS --- both hold together:
1. CLAUSE ARCHITECTURE PRESERVED --- the same clause inventory and nesting depth per period, in any word order and words you choose.
2. COHERENT --- one continuous, fully sensible passage in the target scenario; new lexicon,
   no trace of any source content.

Write modern, natural English. Produce the 10 periods in order as continuous prose --- no
numbering, no headings. Output ONLY the passage: no preamble, no self-audit.

gens.text:
The cashier swiped the first item briskly.
She aimed to glide each product over the scanner, hoping the rush would soon dissolve, as the bell above the door chimed anew.
Behind the divider bar, bags stacked neatly, ready for the flood of goods awaiting their containment.
A new customer edged closer, her presence hinted at by the shadow pressing against the back of the queue.
In the brief silence, the machine emitted a soft beep, declaring the subtotal with mechanical precision, just before the screen blinked with the request for loyalty points.
Before the shopper could retrieve her card, another voice urged haste, their breath warm on the neck of the person ahead.
The conveyor belt hummed steadily, a relentless reminder of time’s passage, while the shopper rummaged through her purse, searching desperately for the elusive plastic rectangle.
After the card was inserted, the machine paused, then spurted out a receipt that fluttered briefly before settling onto the countertop.
With a final beep, the transaction concluded, allowing the line to inch forward, if only slightly.

The clerk scanned each item swiftly under the blaring lights.

To process every barcode quickly, she adjusted her stance when the queue grew impatient behind the divider.

Bags piled high.

A shopper leaned in close, eager for a spot ahead.

Annoyed, she glanced back, where another pushed past the line just scanned.

Behind her, the machine hummed continuously to finalize the transaction.

As the final beep sounded, the customer retrieved her loyalty card promptly.

Each item totaled, the receipt printed with a crisp slice.

Above the counter, two signs flickered, one for cash and another for card payments.

She handed over the receipt, eager for her next customer.

The cashier scanned each item swiftly.

She intended to finish quickly, even as the line behind grew longer, hoping to avoid delays that annoyed customers.

Shoppers pushed forward eagerly.

Each beep signaled another product on the conveyor belt, which moved steadily under the scanner.

Amid the hum of machinery, a shopper jostled from behind, squeezing past the divider bar, while the total flashed onto the screen.

The cashier paused to speak, gesturing to a relative calm spot near the bagging area, hoping to ease the tension infinitively.

When she finally swiped the loyalty card through the reader, the transaction accelerated.

The receipt printed swiftly, detailing every item purchased.

Two shoppers hovered anxiously, awaiting their turn, one insisting on a discount while the other searched for coins to pay.

The final tally was read aloud, followed by the polite request for payment.

In flurriest hours, cashiers zipped crates briskly.

Scanners buzzed fiercely as clerks swiftly scanned every item, while impatient shoppers tapped feet anxiously behind them.

Belts whirred.

Dividers split each transaction neatly, marking zones clearly.

Behind, eager crowds pressed tightly, where hurried bags were stuffed hastily.

Zippers sealed snugly, shoppers leaned forward expectantly.

When totals flashed brightly, voices chimed out figures sharply.

Carts lingered.

Readers pinged loyally, fetching cards swiftly, shoppers reached eagerly for receipts, scanning texts carefully.

Smiles nodded warmly, handing over paper trails precisely.

At the peak rush, the conveyor hummed steadily.

The cashier swiped each item briskly, intending to expedite through the queue, while murmuring totals under her breath, ensuring efficiency.

Shoppers jostled close.

Behind the divider bar, another patron edged forward, their cart nearly spilling items.

Frustration rose when the beep signaled the total, prompting yet another person to nudge closer, questioning space rights.

The shopper hesitated, eyeing their loyalty card tucked inside a wallet.

Before placing the items into bags, she scanned the crowd, seeing another eager face.

Quickly, before tensions flared further, she inserted the card, anticipating the scanner's recognition to conclude transactions swiftly.

Receipt in hand, she stepped aside, allowing the next impatient shopper to proceed smoothly.

The fluxulator hummed softly as shoppers rushed past.

Flurrians pushed their cradles toward the whizzer, hoping swiftly to flit beyond, where grombots buzzed quietly beneath the shimmering zonar, which scanned each item before it glided onto the fluxulator.

Bags piled neatly by the exit.

Clatters echoed across the aisle divider.

Flingers zipped through lines behind the cashier’s stool, where another shopper squeezed forward, causing a slight scuffle over the queue’s width.

The grombot beeped, announcing totals with chirps, while the zonar waited expectantly for cards near the flitter.

Amidst the chaos, the cashier glanced sidelong.

Receipts fluttered down onto the counter.

Behind each transaction, the zonar’s gleam flickered under the fluxulator’s purr, as shoppers eagerly awaited their rewards, preparing to dash out once more.

A final clatter marked their departure from the bustling aisle.

The shopper pushed the cart toward the conveyor belt.

Swiftly scanning each item, the cashier aimed to minimize wait, hoping to ease the tension mounting as another patron pressed close behind, eager to move forward, though lines were rigidly marked.

Items zipped by.

Behind the divider, the barcode scanner chirped repeatedly.

When the total flashed brightly, just then, another shopper leaned even more insistently, murmuring about the narrow space, which the first shopper felt keenly, turning to glance with annoyance.

The card reader buzzed impatiently, prompting for loyalty cards from the now slightly irritated customer.

As bags swished into place at the bagging station, the second shopper jostled again.

A frazzled cashier handed over the receipt, eyes on the next batch of items already queued up, the endless stream stretching before them.

Beyond the divider, another line formed, each shopper waiting their turn, anticipating the beep that signaled their moment at the bustling register where totals were announced and loyalty points redeemed.

Finally, a gentle reminder echoed, inviting another customer to begin their transaction.

The conveyor belt hummed steadily, signaling readiness.

Cashiers scanned barcodes swiftly, aiming to complete transactions briskly, hoping to reduce the growing line behind the divider bar; meanwhile, shoppers checked items off their mental lists, eager to hasten the process.

Bags were stuffed briskly.

Behind the divider, another shopper edged closer, impatient.

When the final beep sounded, announcing the total, whispers of loyalty points prompted sighs, as the next in line tapped feet with frustration.

A receipt printed silently, while the shopper searched wallets hurriedly, intending to pay without delay.

Before the card reader could buzz, the crowded aisle made voices rise.

As cashiers reconciled the day’s earnings, shoppers debated the merits of bulk buying, oblivious to the strained cashier who glanced repeatedly at the clock.

Amidst the chaos, a relative silence fell briefly; the bagging area suddenly cleared as shoppers exited, leaving behind the scent of stale coffee and plastic, while the conveyor belt paused momentarily, awaiting the next cart’s contents.

Finally, the transaction concluded smoothly, with a courteous nod from the cashier to the last shopper.

The conveyor buzzed like distant thunder.

Shoppers jostled eagerly to scan their items, waiting impatiently to swipe, as if the swift whoosh of the scanner promised immediate escape.

Queues thickened.

A frazzled cashier managed the line, her eyes darting between the impatient crowd and the endless stream of goods sliding over the belt.

Behind the divider, another customer pressed forward, their irritation palpable when the first shopper hesitated, bags tangled.

The second shopper, eager and brusque, nearly skipped ahead, wanting merely to grab and go.

While the machine beeped out totals, announcements floated above the din, urging loyalty cardholders to tap away.

Receipts fluttered like confetti.

In the chaos, amidst the clatter of bags slamming shut and the incessant beeping, a shopper grumbled under their breath, demanding space.

She handed over her card, expecting the transaction to conclude swiftly.

The crowd surged around the conveyor belt, shoppers jockeying for position.

Blinking lights flickered as the cashier scanned items with practiced swiftness, aiming to clear the line quickly before the rush intensified, which loomed inevitably.

Groceries piled high.

Behind the divider bar, another impatient shopper pressed closer, eager to claim their spot.

With each beep, the barcode scanner chirped loudly, announcing totals that made the shopper glance nervously at the bagging area where their items were stuffed hastily.

The cashier glanced at the card reader, expecting the loyalty card that might delay but also expedite their turn.

As the shopper shuffled forward, clearing space for others, the line stretched beyond the register.

A receipt fluttered down silently, signaling the transaction’s conclusion.

The next customer, already halfway through the transaction, inserted their loyalty card eagerly into the slot, waiting for the final beep to signal completion.

A nod from the cashier signaled satisfaction with the swift exchange.
